welcome.title: Welcome to PowerMeter
welcome.body: Measure your DPS in real time, analyze every fight and plan your character's build in Aion 2.
req.title: Requirements check
req.adminHint: When PowerMeter starts, Windows asks for permission: answer Yes. If you answered No, restart PowerMeter.
req.blocked: Npcap and administrator rights are required to continue.
char.title: Your character
char.name: Character name
char.nameHint: It is also detected automatically from the game window title.
account.title: Account
account.body: Sign in with Discord to upload logs, share builds and profiles and appear in the rankings.
account.browser: Finish signing in on the browser page that just opened.
disclaimer.title: Before you start
disclaimer.body: PowerMeter is an unofficial tool, not affiliated with NCSoft. It passively reads combat data. Use it at your own risk.
search.placeholderLong: Search pages, items, skills, NPCs, dungeons, characters, logs…
search.empty: No results. Game content is in English.
status.noGameHint: Aion 2 is not running. Start the game.
status.waitingHint: Game detected, waiting for combat traffic.
status.connectedHint: The meter is reading data. Start a fight.
status.errorHint: Could not read the meter status.

soon.text: This page is under construction and ships with the release shown.
home.emptyTitle: Start a fight to see your first data
home.emptyText: Start Aion 2 and hit any target: PowerMeter recognizes your character and starts recording. The widget opens automatically.

supporter.title: Thanks to everyone keeping PowerMeter alive
supporter.text: PowerMeter is free and will stay complete for everyone. Patreon supporters keep alive the servers that host logs, rankings and shared builds.
about.a2tools: The capture engine is based on {link} by taengu (GPL-3.0). Thank you!
